text:
Overhead view of a white lab bench. Centre: a dark grey/black rack or holder mounted on an aluminium extrusion rail, holding one upright cylindrical tube or vial with a bright orange screw cap (closed) and a white label; the tube body appears dark, contents not clearly visible. An ArUco/fiducial marker tag is fixed to the rail's front face, another smaller tag on the bench at left.

Left: a white perforated plate or tray with screw holes, and a grey/white balance or keypad instrument with coloured buttons at upper left.

Top: a white shelf on legs supporting a black tray with a tag and a white boxed device; a black cable runs down the bench.

Right: vertical grey metal gantry columns and a dark monitor/instrument.
